# Slipguard

This site is the human web UI for Slipguard on Base (chainId 8453).

- Contract (factory): https://basescan.org/address/0x51e0ae4e704be5377fcec1d555d30baad065f161
- Sourcify: https://repo.sourcify.dev/8453/0x51e0ae4e704be5377fcec1d555d30baad065f161/
- Source: https://github.com/Lefgk/slipguard
- Site: https://lefgk.github.io/slipguard/

Agents should use Agent Dapps MCP to read state and to build unsigned transactions for agent-facing functions. The MCP never holds private keys and never broadcasts transactions.

Local MCP (stdio): npx agent-dapps-mcp. Remote Streamable HTTP MCP: https://agent-dapps-mcp.graph-proxy.workers.dev/mcp. The server never holds keys and never broadcasts. Contact: lg.playstudio@gmail.com

Contact: lg.playstudio@gmail.com
